name: Unruly Children
overview: Scripture clearly emphasizes the importance of honoring and respecting parents, as seen in the command to honor father and mother for a long life in the land given by the Lord (Exodus 20:12). It warns of severe consequences for cursing parents (Leviticus 20:9) and addresses the challenge of a stubborn, rebellious son who refuses to obey parental authority even after discipline (Deuteronomy 21:18). The Bible advocates loving, timely correction through the rod to guide children away from foolishness (Proverbs 13:24; 22:15) and stresses the necessity of training children in the right way so they remain faithful to it into adulthood (Proverbs 22:6). Together, these verses affirm that unruly behavior in children must be met with firm, loving discipline grounded in respect for God’s order within the family.
